Package com.sca4d.core.api.permission

Class OperationNode

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.permission.OperationNode
Direct Known Subclasses:
OperationNode.Module, OperationNode.OperationAction, OperationNode.Resource
public abstract class OperationNode extends Object
表示模块、业务资源或可授予 Operation 构成的固定三层目录节点。
